options.scientific_justification: Insufficient: prespecified prerequisite headroom gates all fail.
options.risk_of_post_hoc_tuning: High: constructing a task loss to rescue a known failed baseline without its entry criterion.
options.experimental_cost: High: generator mechanism, isolated teachers, training, repeated generation and downstream detectors.
options.clean_causal_interpretation: Not available now; failed entry gate cannot be reinterpreted as mechanism authorization.

options.thesis_coherence: A generator-first thesis premise is not supported by current independent baseline evidence.

options.route: Switch to another published generator family
options.scientific_justification: Insufficient in existing evidence: Stage18A is an asset audit, not a demonstrated pre-existing family-to-problem fit rationale.
options.risk_of_post_hoc_tuning: High if families are swept after SD2 failure until one gives positive AP.
options.experimental_cost: High: reconstruct clean lineage, annotation contract, comparable training and raw bank calibration.
options.clean_causal_interpretation: A clean future comparison is conceivable only after an independent scientific rationale and protocol review; not authorized here.
options.overlap_with_BootstrapGuard: Only distinguishable if genuinely raw outputs; existing derived DWBG pool is not a raw alternative.
options.thesis_coherence: A published family alone is not a novel contribution, and asset absence is not proof of family inferiority.

options.route: Pause generator-mechanism-first; reframe innovation1 as non-selector training/data integration
options.scientific_justification: Observed instability and class asymmetry justify asking how fixed synthetic inputs participate in optimization; no integration solution is yet validated.
options.risk_of_post_hoc_tuning: Still material: fitting weights/curricula to RawC or Black final_eval would invalidate confirmation. Label all candidates as exploratory hypotheses.
options.experimental_cost: Conceptual work is zero training now; any future training still needs independent protocol authorization. Avoid generator retraining by definition.
options.clean_causal_interpretation: Potentially cleaner if generator, all samples, total exposure, labels and model are fixed and only a prespecified integration factor varies; no experiment is designed here.
options.overlap_with_BootstrapGuard: Distinct only without retain/drop/rank decisions; uncertainty weighting and distribution guardrails can otherwise become soft selectors.
options.thesis_coherence: Innovation1: how to use synthetic data in optimization; innovation2: which synthetic data to retain. Method novelty/effectiveness still unproved.
